neighbours.label: a line break that cuts a sentence in the middle of a clause (hard-wrapped text), as opposed to a newline at a sentence or paragraph end
fire:
The farmers gathered in the square
to hear the news from the capital.

Most of the soldiers who crossed
the river that night never returned.

Researchers found that children who
read before bed sleep more soundly.

The committee agreed to postpone
the vote until the following spring.

Her grandfather had built the house
with timber from his own forest.

Travellers are advised to carry
water and a map at all times.

The bishop refused to consecrate
the new chapel without royal consent.

Small boats sheltered in the harbour
while the storm passed overhead.
quiet:
The farmers gathered in the square.
They heard the news from the capital.

Most of the soldiers crossed the river that night.
Few of them returned.

Researchers studied children who read before bed.
They slept more soundly.

The committee agreed to postpone the vote.
It will meet again in spring.

Her grandfather had built the house.
The timber came from his own forest.

Travellers are advised to carry water.
A map is also useful.

The bishop refused to consecrate the new chapel.
He wanted royal consent first.

Small boats sheltered in the harbour.
The storm passed overhead.
